metadata.proof: PatientRegistrationForm.clean_username (line 39) checks username uniqueness and raises a distinct ValidationError 'That username is already registered.' No other validation in the form produces this exact message. An unauthenticated attacker can POST to /register/ with candidate usernames; the error response reveals which usernames exist, enabling targeted attacks against known accounts.
